coin.title: Finland 50 Euro “Finnish Veterans” 2025 PF70
coin.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=LMSWKRF]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}A coin of demonstrable perfection in your collection? PF70 is the ultimate grade – a perfect coin with no visible flaws, even under magnification. It’s a true masterpiece of minting, offering flawless beauty and craftsmanship. Add this treasure to your premium collection! Design The Finland 50 Euro “Finnish Veterans” 2025 is designed by Tapio Kettunen. On the obverse, Kettunen created three profiles with the use of negative space. The profiles that can be seen in the negative space are those of a war veteran on the left and of a soldier on the right. The negative space of the war veterans profile may indicate that almost all of the war veterans of 1939-1945 have left us, they continue their lives in the form of memories. In the case of the soldier, the negative space suggests the hope that no more new war veterans should be born. On the far right, a profile of a young person is also shown: the future of the country that hopefully never has to endure war. The reverse shows an altered version of the Finnish flag. The partially broken shape and jagged surface refer to the war.
